items.prompt: Which letters can begin the present tense?
options: Those gathered in anaytu: alif, nūn, yāʾ and tāʾ
items.explanation: Al-Ājurrūmiyya gathers them in anaytu: a-, na-, ya-, ta-.

items.prompt: What is the state of the verb here?
items.explanation: Lam puts the present tense into jazm, shown by the sukūn.
Ta- with the ending -īna is the second person feminine singular.
